title: Perfect introduction to Paris
comment: This was our first tour in Paris and it set the bar very high! Abi's passion for the city is contagious, and her knowledge is impressive. She took us to the Sacré-Cœur, but also showed us quieter spots with amazing views. The small group size made it feel very personal. We learned so much about Parisian art and history. Thank you for such a memorable morning!
